patches.title: Countertop to Dining Table Sweep
patches.principle: After checking all countertops, immediately check all dining tables before opening any container.
patches.when_to_apply: When searching for a cleanable object on open surfaces.

patches.title: Complete Task in Three Moves
patches.principle: Once you pick up the target object, go directly to the transformation station, then directly to the destination.
patches.when_to_apply: When holding the object needed for a manipulation task.

patches.title: Search Descending Order
patches.principle: If target not on countertops, check dining tables, then fridge, then cabinets, then drawers in that order.
patches.when_to_apply: When the target object is not immediately visible on the first surface.
